title: Bass & Flinders Gin Masterclass
summary: Weekly Gin Masterclass at Bass & Flinders Distillery. Participants learn the history of gin; the distillation process; and techniques to create their own bespoke gin recipe. Includes cheese platter and G&T. Each guest leaves with a 500ml bottle of their own signature gin blend. Led by resident Gin E
description: Weekly Gin Masterclass at Bass & Flinders Distillery. Participants learn the history of gin; the distillation process; and techniques to create their own bespoke gin recipe. accessibilityNotes: Distillery door wheelchair accessible; rooftop access — check with venue
